full_judgment: 38. It is the presumption that the legislature does not make mistakes in not adding or inserting the said word 'currency' in the said sub-sections. Even if, the mistake is obvious, the Court can not correct it as it would amount to legislation which is outside the domain of interpretation; a Court of Law is bound to proceed on the assumption that the legislature is an ideal person that does not make mistakes.
